liebermann.notes: Benedictional and pontifical of the late 10th century from Newminster, Winchester, for its abbot Æthelgar (later bishop of Selsey and archbishop of Canterbury), formerly owned by Archbishop Robert of Canterbury, then Rouen Cathedral; f. 162 Consecratio regis with the Sacramentum coronationis. Cf. Rj.
